title: coder: pasted screenshots and image files reach the model
body:
Today a pasted `data:image` attaches, then the provider refuses it: "This text-only provider cannot accept image attachments" (`crates/coder-new/src/lib.rs:968`). A pasted file path is inserted as text.

Do:
- Send images to vision-capable routes through the gateway (input_image).
- A dropped or pasted path to a png/jpg/pdf attaches it.
- Pass images through to delegated Claude Code/Codex children.
- Show a thumbnail chip in the composer.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Pasting a screenshot and asking "what's wrong here" gets an answer that describes the image.
- [ ] The test covers path-drop and the size limit.

Phase: This weekend. Parity doc: https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/kitchen-sink/orchestrator-parity.md (row I1). Part of the orchestrator-parity umbrella.
